map.CKD-EPI 和 MDRD 哪个准？: Which is more accurate, CKD-EPI or MDRD?
map.CKD-EPI（2009）在较高 eGFR 区间比旧版 MDRD 更准、更少高估: CKD-EPI (2009) is more accurate than the older MDRD at higher eGFR ranges and overestimates less, so it is now usually the first choice. Both are expressed in mL/min/1.73m2 (standardized body surface area) for population comparison; individual follow-up should fix one formula to read the trend.
map.eGFR 正常就代表肾脏完全健康吗？: Does a normal eGFR mean the kidneys are completely healthy?
map.不一定。eGFR 反映滤过率，早期肾损伤（如微量白蛋白尿、肾小球硬化）可出现在: Not necessarily. eGFR reflects filtration rate, and early kidney damage (such as microalbuminuria or glomerulosclerosis) can appear while eGFR is still normal. Assessing kidney health also requires the urine albumin/creatinine ratio, blood pressure and imaging, not eGFR alone.
